description: Upgrade plan to migrate project to Java 25

tasks.reason: Java 25 is the latest LTS release, bringing performance improvements, new language features, and long-term support.
tasks.requirements: Upgrade JDK to Java 25. Update build configuration (pom.xml or build.gradle) to target Java 25. Ensure all source and target compiler settings are updated to Java 25. Resolve any compilation errors or deprecation warnings introduced by the Java 25 upgrade.
